capture_metadata.one_pickup_fixture: Two actual overlap collections plus three forced world drops before CSV; normal lifetime decay

carried_weapon_combat.scope_limit: This workload establishes only its requested carried family/variant. Last-shot contact counters repeat until the next shot and are not cumulative event totals.

pickup_occupancy.scope_limit: Pickups were forced through the normal authority; timed effects activated through actual overlap before CSV. Lifetimes and collection continue normally. Setup presence is not continuous occupancy.

input.sampling_note: ProfileSeconds is the actual actor counter. CSV cumulative FrameTime and 10Hz world observations are separate clocks; no invented offset or row interpolation.

full.selection: Every numeric CSV frame row; no trimming
full.scope_interpretation: MachineState, MachineVisual and PresentationDriver are regular inclusive timing scopes; MachineVisual is nested inside MachineState on ordinary ticks. Physics/Chaos scopes can nest and aggregate workers. All scopes remain separate; no sum or subtraction estimates unique CPU wall time.

gpu.reason: No GPU attribution or GPU improvement is inferred from capped CPU frame timings.
